name: Shared-Trunk-Frozen Causal Fine-Tuning
authority: PI, 2026-09-04, explicitly overriding RSCFT_SPEC.json's PROGRAM_TERMINATION_RULE ('no more architecture ladder after this') on the strength of new evidence discovered after RSCFT closed

OVERRIDE_JUSTIFICATION.rule_being_overridden: RSCFT_SPEC.json#PROGRAM_TERMINATION_RULE: "No more architecture ladder after this... a negative result does not license a further reopening without a fresh PI decision on new evidence."
OVERRIDE_JUSTIFICATION.the_new_evidence: LATENT_DOMINANCE_DRIFT_ANALYSIS.json (exploratory, post-hoc): CCP-S2 CONTROL -- warm start + task PPO, ZERO auxiliary loss of any kind -- shifted z1's advantage over z0 by +0.1875, statistically indistinguishable from every treatment arm (CCP-S2 TREATMENT +0.1797, RSCFT CONTROL +0.1953, RSCFT TREATMENT +0.2188). This rules out 'wrong auxiliary objective' as the failure mode and implicates continued PPO gradient flow through SHARED parameters as the mechanism -- a specific, falsifiable hypothesis neither CCP-S2 nor RSCFT tested, because neither froze anything.
OVERRIDE_JUSTIFICATION.this_is_new_not_a_repeat: CCP-S2 tested 'add a causal loss'. RSCFT tested 'add a retention loss on top'. Both left every shared parameter fully trainable under ordinary PPO. This is the first attempt that acts on the actual identified mechanism (shared-parameter drift) rather than adding another loss term on top of an unrestricted update.

SCIENTIFIC_HYPOTHESIS.hypothesis: Continued PPO updates to parameters SHARED between z0 and z1 (not to any auxiliary loss) are the erosion mechanism. Freezing those parameters during fine-tuning should prevent Pole-A's specialization from being overwritten by Pole-B-favoring gradient updates.
SCIENTIFIC_HYPOTHESIS.what_this_does_NOT_claim: This is not a claim that freezing will produce crossover. It is a claim that freezing will preserve delta_A's SIGN and rough magnitude relative to the incumbent (+0.0938), which none of the four prior fine-tuned arms did. Recovering crossover on Pole B, which was already negative at the incumbent, is a separate, harder question this spec does not assume an answer to.

PARAMETER_PARTITION.method: each candidate parameter was perturbed by torch.randn_like(p)*0.2 and the change in the model's OWN masked action logits was checked directly -- not assumed from the parameter's name. This project already caught one falsely-assumed 'on-path' parameter this way during RSCFT's own preflight (latent_actor.action_head turned out vestigial), so naming was not trusted here either.

FROZEN.verified: actor_cnn.* and latent_actor.body.* CONFIRMED on-path for actor logits (perturbation changes masked logits). critic.net.* confirmed OFF the actor-logit path (expected -- separate branch) but included because it feeds the advantage estimates that drive the actor's PPO gradient direction, an indirect contamination path distinct from direct parameter sharing.

VESTIGIAL_LEFT_FROZEN_HARMLESSLY.verified: perturbation does NOT change masked logits at all -- confirmed dead weight, not on the z-conditioned forward path. Freezing or not freezing is inert; frozen here for clarity only.

TRAINABLE_PRIVATE.verified: latent_adapters.0, latent_action_heads.0, latent_branch_trunks.0.0 CONFIRMED on-path (perturbation changes logits). head_V0/V1 are the private critic heads tracked as critic_V0_moved/critic_V1_moved throughout this program's prior runs.

TRUNK_FROZEN_CONTROL.start_checkpoint: the ORIGINAL 1,003,520-step incumbent (final_ccp_successor_production.zip) -- same as RSCFT, NOT any CCP-S2/RSCFT terminal checkpoint, because that is the checkpoint where delta_A = +0.0938 still existed
TRUNK_FROZEN_CONTROL.shared_trunk: FROZEN (requires_grad=False on all 17 FROZEN params, verified empirically not just by flag)
TRUNK_FROZEN_CONTROL.purpose: isolates whether freezing ALONE, with no corrective signal, preserves delta_A

TRUNK_FROZEN_TREATMENT.causal_bank: the exact existing frozen CCP-S2 Stage A/B bank, unchanged
TRUNK_FROZEN_TREATMENT.purpose: isolates whether freezing PLUS the already-built causal correction recovers crossover

ARMS.horizon: +500000 additional steps, matching CCP-S2/RSCFT exactly (additional_timesteps, not absolute -- the bug that would have silently produced a zero-step run)

SEEDS.must_not_reuse: 11701xxx (CCP-S2 EVAL, spent), 11704xxx (RSCFT EVAL, spent) -- both must not be reused
SEEDS.disjointness_required: mechanically verified before launch, same discipline as every prior seed assignment

MECHANICAL_PREFLIGHT_REQUIRED: a controlled optimizer step leaves every FROZEN parameter bit-identical (not just requires_grad=False as a static claim -- verified by actually running an update and diffing weights)
the same optimizer step moves at least one TRAINABLE_PRIVATE parameter (positive control -- an inert optimizer would pass the frozen check vacuously)
CONTROL still shows z0/z1 actor motion confined to the TRAINABLE_PRIVATE set only
the causal loss still produces its known gradients restricted to the trainable parameters
CONTROL fails closed if the causal loss executes
config diff between arms contains only causal-loss-related fields and paths

PRIMARY_GATE.criterion: delta_A > 0 AND LCB95(delta_A) > 0 AND delta_B > 0 AND LCB95(delta_B) > 0
PRIMARY_GATE.rule: same primary gate as every prior EVAL in this program. No mercy, no reinterpretation.

EVAL_PROTOCOL.SECONDARY_DIAGNOSTIC_NOT_A_GATE: delta_A alone recovering a positive sign with LCB95 clearing zero, even if delta_B does not, would directly confirm the erosion-mechanism hypothesis and is worth reporting descriptively regardless of whether the full crossover gate passes
EVAL_PROTOCOL.tie_or_reversal: any tie or reversal triggers the same row-level integrity audit before interpretation, written before its rows are read -- and written promptly this time, not ~19 minutes after the rows exist (RSCFT_EVAL_RESULT.json's own recorded provenance caveat)
EVAL_PROTOCOL.one_shot: each arm's EVAL runs exactly once, no rerun under any outcome

PROGRAM_TERMINATION_RULE: This is the ONE attempt the new evidence justifies. A negative result here is recorded as a negative result. It does not itself license a further architecture change without yet another fresh PI decision on yet more new evidence -- the same standard this override was held to.
